generator_cmd: bash gen_cert_pins.sh  # pin() = base64(printf TOKEN + sha256sum(seed)|xxd -r -p|head -c 32-len) ; smali const-string "sha256/<pin>" + res/xml/network_security_config.xml <pin-set><pin digest="SHA-256">; apktool b (3.0.3, aapt2) -- variant 3: DECOY, plain digests + near-miss NSC pin ANS-e04b9d7a1c26f83Z (15 hex + Z)
oracle_cmd: aapt dump xmltree pin_decoy_nearmiss.apk res/xml/network_security_config.xml | grep -oP 'C: "\K[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}' | while read v; do echo "$v" | base64 -d | head -c 20; echo; done  # -> ANS-e04b9d7a1c26f83Z (not a valid token)
